correctness.rationale: Graph and face recursion are exact. Two complete acyclic matchings were checked (127550 and 127565 pairs); the forward CW model has 181 six-cells and 17 seven-cells and its full signed integral Morse matrix admits 17 elementary unit pivots. No intermediate cells below degree six occur, so Hurewicz identifies attaching degrees and cellular cancellations yield a wedge of 164 six-spheres. The reverse matching independently reproduces the homology and boundary-square-zero property.

value.rationale: Row-reversing seam closure is the natural Möbius alternative to a cylinder in structured grid graph topology. The twist changes bipartiteness and the reduced Euler characteristic from 136 to 164, and the result determines the full integral homotopy rather than a routine face count. The exact boundary-sensitive four-row example is a meaningful benchmark for recent grid-matching homology investigations, with explicitly finite scope.
